nodes.label: Android Monochrome App Icon (Avantej Native)
nodes.description: Android adaptive icon monochrome variant for the Avantej React Native (Expo) app. Displays a stylized upward-pointing chevron/caret shape (resembling the letter A) in medium gray (#808080 approx) on a white/transparent background. This is the monochrome foreground layer used by Android 13+ for themed icons. The design is minimal and geometric, consistent with the Avantej brand mark.
nodes.design_intent: Monochrome adaptive icon layer for Android themed icon support. The gray-on-white chevron represents the Avantej logomark. Used by Android OS to tint the icon to match the system color palette.
